title: Which organizations the official record names most
question: Which organizations already appear in audits, grand-jury reports, prosecutors' filings and ethics orders, and how often?
finding: 1,281 documents were searched for 1,002 names. 323 organizations are named in at least one official document, and 248 in an audit, integrity review, grand-jury report, City Attorney action or prosecutor's record. Documents naming 37 people who appear in case files are indexed too, and are listed on those cases rather than ranked here.
how: Each document's text was searched for the whole name of every profiled nonprofit, every person, company, nonprofit or committee drawn in a case file, and the 300 largest business payees. A match needs the full name written as a name (capitalized), after dropping suffixes such as Inc. Names made of one common word, or two generic ones, are not searched. Counts are documents, not mentions.
limits: Being named is not being accused: an audit of a department names its contractors, a grand-jury report lists who it spoke to, and the City's yearly nonprofit-monitoring report lists every nonprofit it checked, including those with no findings. Read the document. Abbreviations and nicknames are missed, 94 scanned documents have no searchable text, and the library is a selection, not every document the City has issued.
